display.title: Episode 536: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 3 (Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Tammuz and the hope for the third Beis HaMikdash, a cheder class sings a song about Moshiach, and a lost child knocks on Avraham and Sarah's door during a blizzard.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in the first week of Tammuz 5752. Uncle Yossi reminds children to keep Torah, davening and tzedakah in their summer routine, and explains that Tammuz contains the sad fast of the 17th, when the walls of Yerushalayim were breached, leading to the Churban on Tisha B'Av. Still, we trust Hashem to end the golus and celebrate the dedication of the third Beis HaMikdash, and the march is set to 'Mizmor Shir Chanukas HaBayis' from Tehillim 30. A first-grade class from a Crown Heights cheder leads the Shema, gives tzedakah, and sings a song about Moshiach based on the Rambam's Hilchos Melachim; one of the boys leads a prayer for the Rebbe's recovery, and there is a short promotion for the teacher's new parsha tapes. Story time continues 'The Ten Wedding Gifts': three months after the wedding, on a stormy winter night, a lost, freezing boy knocks at Avraham and Sarah's cottage. They warm him, feed him and put him to bed. He is the only son of the local poritz, who is frantically searching for him. The show ends with Tehillim for the Rebbe's recovery and candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Even in sad times like Tammuz, trust that Hashem will end the golus; and be kind to anyone in need, as Avraham and Sarah were.

date.note: 'Here we are already in the month of Tammuz', with 17 Tammuz still ahead; Friday candle-lighting 8:09 fits 10 July 1992; one week before episode 537 (Yud-Gimmel Tammuz, 14 July 1992).
